player_prompt.intro:
Ukinira Tower of Hanoi na {num_disks} disks.
Wakuye disks kuva kuri tower A ugatange kuri tower C.
Igihe ukora disk, andika tower ya kubanza na tower ya kugera (kwa mfano, '[A C]').
Kumbuka ko ushobora gukora disk imwe, kandi ko disk kubwa ntacyo ikagwa kuri disk ndogo.
Ku ruhusa rwawe, tuma igikorwa kimwe.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Watanze isoko cyangwa umunara wo kugenzura bidafite agaciro.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Wagerageje kwimura disiki iri ku munara w'inzu y'ibiro by'ishami.
invalid_move.same_tower: Wagerageje kwimurira disiki muri iyo nyubako.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Wagerageje gushyira disiki nini ku yindi ntoya.

game_action.moved: Wahinduye disiki {disk} kuva kuri {source} ujya ku {target}.

outcome.win: Urakoze cyane, washoboye gukemura ikibazo cy'umunara wa Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Umupaka w'impinduka urageze. Washyize neza {pct}% ya disiki ku munara C.
